objective: Ensure galaxy-scale narrative fidelity by limiting unrealistic character interactions.

components.name: Character Encounter Likelihood Engine
components.description: Assigns probability scores to potential interactions based on distance, faction transit access, and memory pathways.

components.name: Narrative Cluster Partitioning
components.description: Divides characters into location-anchored clusters (e.g., Core Worlds, Outer Colonies) to localize narrative influence.

components.name: Memory Echo Range Limiter
components.description: Restricts indirect memory propagation unless a shared network, event chain, or temporal lag justifies access.

components.name: Rare Character Trigger System
components.description: Requires high-stakes narrative tension or multi-thread convergence to activate central character involvement.

components.name: Timeline Staggering for Interactions
components.description: Models spatial-temporal delays (e.g., travel time, signal lag) to prevent real-time implausibility.

governance.oversight: Original Expert Panel + Project Lead Approval
